deliberate_changes: New bounded wait helper and exact child close observation.
Producer drain races encoder termination to avoid stranded waits.
Failure destroys only owned input, attempts SIGTERM then SIGKILL with 5-second close waits, and rethrows original error; cleanup failure remains explicit warning.
limitations: Synthetic ordinary-main VM substitutes canvas/scene/FFmpeg process; no native encoder, video rendering/decoding or physical process/FD proof.
Public media bytes unchanged; no application/runtime workflow or release/gate changes.
